The deep midnight blue background features gently floating petals. The lighting shifts to highlight the vivid red of the flowers with a magical, pulsing glow.

Style: Masterpiece, high quality, 8k resolution, dynamic motion, magical realism, enchanting atmosphere. Duration: 8 seconds.
